source_of_truth_note: This result is reconciled directly against the committed A2 experiment and the four GitHub Actions artifacts. An earlier first-write reconstruction used stale profile/metric values and was corrected before opening A3; the 3-of-4 scientific conclusion did not change.

frozen_search_identity.selection_rule: first passing fixture in committed profile order then ascending frozen supply order

B01.interpretation: Preserves the committed A1 positive-control profile and first passing 5*KSAT supply fixture.

B12.interpretation: The A1 second-node -1 cm scope collision is removed by the committed finite drier-profile search without changing event physics or tolerances.

O13.interpretation: The A1 second-node -1 cm scope collision is removed by the committed finite drier-profile search without changing event physics or tolerances.

O14.supply_grid_sensitivity: weak; changing 1.5..12 KSAT does not remove the lower-bound pathology
O14.local_balance_observation: At representative lower-bound trials q01 exceeds qtop, so the fixed h0=0 top-cell event would require storage gain while the local flux difference drives storage loss; the optimizer therefore collapses tau toward zero.
O14.important_nonconclusion: This does not prove that an isolated O14 top-node h=0 event root is physically impossible. With KSATFIT=2.495984 cm/d and the 0..1 cm surface-head scope, qtop can reach about 1.2*KSATFIT=2.9951808 cm/d; this exceeds representative P0 q01, so root existence remains an open topology/solver question.

global_interpretation: The finite committed initial-profile search resolves the prior B12 and O13 fixture-scope failures and preserves B01 as the unchanged positive control.
O14 fails all 24 frozen cases at the event-time lower bound and becomes worse as the frozen profile is made drier.
Therefore extending the profile grid, lowering the tau floor, or changing the supply grid is not justified by A2 evidence.
The next step must be reference-only O14 root-existence/event-topology diagnosis before any Ross candidate or qualification policy changes.
hard_guards: Do not lower the 1e-8 day event-time floor based on this result.
Do not extend or tune the A2 profile/supply grids after observing O14.
Do not treat the O14 fixture failure as a Ross-physics falsification.
Do not alter the characterized B01/B12/O13 fixtures in A3.
A3 is diagnostic/reference-only and may not qualify a production candidate.

architecture_checks.mass_conservation: All selected B01/B12/O13 fixtures close within the frozen mass gate; invalid O14 trials are not committed.
architecture_checks.transactionality: Committed input state remains unchanged during characterization trials.
architecture_checks.physics_solver_policy_separation: No material-specific physics or tolerance changes were introduced; only a frozen fixture grid was characterized.

hard_nonclaims: No simultaneous multi-node saturation topology qualification.
No production, runtime, MultiSWAP, response-tangent or groundwater admission.
